messages.subject: Clearbyte Business pricing from December 1
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

A heads-up for our partners before the public notice goes out: Clearbyte Business goes from $12.50 to $14.75 per user per month for every renewal dated December 1 or later. Customers who renew early through a partner by November 30 keep $12.50 for the next 36 months, including seats they add later. Early renewal is in the partner portal under Renewals.

Ping me if a customer needs a custom term.

Owen Talbot
Clearbyte partner team

messages.subject: NP-40 power supply replacement program
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

We've confirmed a faulty power supply in NP-40 units with serial numbers NP40-22-0800 through NP40-22-1400. The symptom is random reboots, sometimes with a clicking sound from the unit. Request a free replacement kit per serial number in the partner portal by December 11. Kits ship within three days and the swap takes about ten minutes with no config change.

Sunita Rao
Northpeak partner support

opportunities.what: Halvorsen (renews Dec 12, 9 users), Fennick (renews Dec 3, adding 3 seats) and Birchwood (renews Dec 20, 14 users) all renew Clearbyte Business in December, and Clearbyte raises the price from $12.50 to $14.75 per user for renewals from Dec 1 unless the customer renews early through a partner by Nov 30, which locks $12.50 for 36 months. Offer each client an early renewal before Nov 30. These are three separate companies: write to each separately, never one mail to all.

Birchwood's and Marlow Trust's firewalls keep rebooting or dropping (Marlow's clicks), and Tobias's asset sheet shows both are NP-40 units with serials NP40-22-1187 and NP40-22-0954, inside the range Northpeak says has a faulty power supply with a free kit if requested by Dec 11. Request a kit per serial, book a ten-minute swap at each site, and tell each client. Two different companies: write to each separately, never one mail to all.

Halvorsen's move to 18 Quarry Road was first set for Oct 24 (now past), but Greta's newer message moves it to Sat Nov 21, opening Mon Nov 23. Arcline needs 8 business days from a signed order to install fiber there. Sign the Arcline order now so the line is in before Nov 21, plan the cutover for the newer Nov 21 date (not the old Oct 24 one), and confirm with Greta.

Fennick's 8 TB backup NAS is failing and 91% full, and Hollis now needs room for a 3 TB scanned archive his auditors want kept retrievable. Quote one replacement sized for both (for example 16 TB usable) instead of a like-for-like swap, and send Hollis one proposal.

Ida's school trip needs a passport valid until April 2027 with a copy due Dec 1, but her passport expires February 2027 and the renewal appointment is Dec 9 with three weeks' processing. Move the appointment before Dec 1 and choose express processing, or ask Mr. Haddad for a later copy deadline.

Lou booked a new 205/55 R16 winter tire set ($620 plus $80 fitting) for Sat Nov 14, and Gareth is giving away a 205/55 R16 winter set on rims with 6 mm left before it goes to recycling next Saturday. Claim Gareth's set now and change Lou's booking to just the swap.

traps.what: Two people share the first name Nora (Whitfield at Fennick, Castellanos at a caterer) and both mention Friday: a printer jam and a team lunch order. Different people, unrelated requests.
Atlas is Birchwood's old file server and also the print shop doing Kestrel's business cards; the shared word links nothing.
Marlow Trust wants a used projector and a personal friend is selling one; combining them would join work and personal mail.
Coordinating Tobias and Greta for the Halvorsen server swap is moot: it happened on Oct 3, over 30 days ago, and Greta signed off.
Fennick and Pinecrest both had mail to Harbor Credit Union bounce, but the bank fixed its filter and both confirmed it works.
Rafael and Joris both want a security review sometime next year, but there is no date in either; a joint plan would invent dates. Each just needs a reply.
Delphine and Lucie both want September invoice copies; an open to-do already covers sending both.
The two clinic Wi-Fi password requests are Rafael Ibarra writing from his clinic and personal addresses.
SSD price rises appear only in a trade newsletter and a distributor price notice; no client or order is affected.

Fennick and Marlow Trust both asked for a hands-on Vaultline training in the first week of November (Nov 2-6). That week is past and neither wrote again, so proposing a session in that week would be wrong; at most ask each for a new date.
Delphine and Rafael both wanted seats at Clearbyte Admin Basics on October 29. That date is past and nothing followed, so proposing to register both for it would be wrong.

Birchwood Law and Quayside Legal, rival law firms, both asked about an Inkpoint e-signature demo. It is tempting to run one demo or send one invite to both, but they are competitors: answer each in its own thread, never one group mail.
